action_summary: Corrects the previous identification round's bottleneck by measurement. That round measured the goal's minimal class as two statements over 555 runs of three machines and concluded the last bit can only be closed by language, pricing it at one question of the user. This round runs 983 traces of FIVE real machines (three fitted, git and sort never fitted): both statements agree with the goal's own judge on 0 of 983 disagreements, and still are not the same function. Over 38 791 count histories exactly one is equivalent to the judge; the other differs on 42, with the witness counts 0 -> 2 in one step. No atom of any of the five machines adds two copies in one step, so no run at any depth could ever exhibit the witness: the residual was outside the ACTION ALPHABET, not a shortage of evidence. The survivor needs one checkable precondition (count(initial) == 0, one read, 5 of 5 machines). Zero questions of the user, zero parameters: the bit is paid by proof, and a proof is cheaper than a question and permanent in a way a question is not.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: Agreement is not equivalence. Consistency with the goal on any finite set of runs is evidence; identity with the goal is a proof. Permanence is proven equivalence under a precondition a new environment can check with one read -- not the number of experiences, and not a question of the user.
